description: MOSAIC's phase state of one size bin as EqWeFiC writes it (components/aerosol/mosaic: aerosol_phase_state.esm and mesa_salt_equilibrium.esm, which state the residuals and leave the iterations to the integrator; D95). Two nested solves before the aerosol's gas-particle transfer: the Kelvin equilibrium of the bin's water activity, a scalar root (WRF-Chem iterates it by fixed point to 1e-2), and MESA's solid-liquid equilibrium, fifteen solid salt amounts that cannot be negative or exceed what each salt's ions allow (the bounds are the model's: lb 0 and ub a variable on elec_s, so the run config names only the method), whose rate S - 1 makes it a complementarity problem (WRF-Chem integrates it by explicit pseudo-time steps to a 1% driving force, at most 80). The operator and variable names are illustrative until the MOSAIC assembly is written.
